newsitem.title: USA: Northern 544 MW Minn. nuke at full power.
newsitem.headline: Northern 544 MW Minn. nuke at full power.

text.p: Northern States Power Co's 544 megawatt Monticello nuclear power plant was operating at full capacity Friday, returning from an outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
An NRC daily plant status report showed the Monticello, Minnesota plant as operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Friday.
The plant tripped off line Nov 12 due to an operator error.
About 35 percent of Northern States' power production comes from the Monticello facility and two Prairie Island nuclear units in Red Wing, Minn.
